result.summary: Caches serialized compact block messages for relay to low-bandwidth peers, extending existing caching that was previously limited to high-bandwidth peers. It also changes serialization from deferred to asynchronous execution, consolidates recent compact block tracking state into a dedicated struct, and unifies shared sending logic.
result.problem: Nodes currently do not cache serialized compact block messages when serving low-bandwidth compact block announcements. Additionally, unblocking work to support prefilled compact blocks (#35558) risks repeatedly serializing multiple compact block message variants without shared caching structures.
evidence: Author description: 'Performance is less critical for low-bandwidth peers, so this change on its own should have little impact on block propagation, but these refactors are useful as part of https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35558 which adds prefilling of compact blocks...'

Commit 42a992816a: 'This also changes std::launch::deferred to std::launch::async since we are likely going to use this result very soon if someone has requested HB blocks from us, and if no one has, then performance here is not that critical.'
result.scope_notes: The diff was omitted from the prompt. In addition to caching for low-bandwidth peers, commits touch async thread launch policies and refactor compact block sending logic.
result.card: Extends compact block message caching to low-bandwidth peer relay and switches compact block serialization to asynchronous execution. The author notes that standalone impact on block propagation is minimal since low-bandwidth peers are not on the latency-critical path, but the refactor prepares compact block relay structures for prefill support in #35558. A regression could disrupt or delay block announcements and propagation across P2P peers.
uncertainties: The diff was not provided, so the exact mechanism for thread synchronization and the async caching structure cannot be verified directly.

risk.why: A flaw in compact block caching or asynchronous serialization could stall or corrupt block relay across P2P connections.
